about: The Workbench icons of the CommanderGenius drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Commander Genius's own logo (share/cg.64.png, GPL 2 like the program). CommanderGenius-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CommanderGenius.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's CommanderGenius.info. Data.info is the icon of global/ and global/gfx/, Games.info of Games/ (the Makefile copies them to each name).
